Subject: Procurement onboarding — scheduling MAP & PO checklist call

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to move forward. To get vendor setup and PO routing started, can we schedule a short (25–30 min) procurement onboarding call this week? Goal: align on Mutual Action Plan (MAP), confirm the PO flow and invoicing contacts, and collect the vendor forms we need to complete Redwood's procurement intake.

Proposed agenda (30 minutes):
- Introductions & stakeholders (5m)
- MAP / timeline & milestones (10m)
- Vendor setup forms / required docs (W9, SOC2 summary, bank details) (8m)
- PO process / invoicing address, PO numbering, and expected lead times (5m)

Availability options (PST):
- Fri 2026-03-06, 10:00–10:30 or 15:00–15:30
- Mon 2026-03-09, 09:30–10:00 or 14:00–14:30

We have a short procurement checklist attached to this message to speed the intake: Redwood_procurement_checklist_v1.pdf. If you prefer, we can share a collaborative MAP in Google Sheets during the call.

Please loop in anyone else on Acme's side (procurement manager, finance) who should attend. If Jordan from procurement should be on this thread, happy to include him.

Next steps: reply with preferred time and any additional stakeholders.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
